schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT A1.FIRST_LOGIN AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (A1.FIRST_LOGIN + 1) = A2.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FIRST_LOGIN FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS A1 JOIN ACTIVITY AS A2 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = A2.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY A1.FIRST_LOGIN
q2: WITH INSTALL_DATE AS ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS INSTALL_DT FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT A.INSTALL_DT, COUNT(A.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN B.PLAYER_ID>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(A.PLAYER_ID),2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM INSTALL_DATE A LEFT JOIN (SELECT ID.INSTALL_DT, ID.PLAYER_ID FROM INSTALL_DATE ID JOIN ACTIVITY A ON ID.INSTALL_DT=A.EVENT_DATE-1 AND ID.PLAYER_ID = A.PLAYER_ID ) B ON A.INSTALL_DT=B.INSTALL_DT AND A.PLAYER_ID = B.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY 1
